facts.text: Work began in 1988 as a new NES Zelda. About a year in, the team moved it to the Super Nintendo.
Directed by Takashi Tezuka and produced by Shigeru Miyamoto, with music by Koji Kondo.
It filled an 8-megabit cartridge, twice the size of most Super Nintendo games of its day.
To save space, the Dark World isn't a second map: the game draws it as an overlay on the Light World.
In Japan it's Kamigami no Triforce, "Triforce of the Gods". For the West, the priest Agahnim became a wizard.
Hold the sword button, then let go: a spin attack hits everything around you.
Four Pieces of Heart make a new Heart Container, one more unit of health. Search every corner.
Stuck in the Dark World? Only the Magic Mirror brings you back to the Light World.
Keep hitting a chicken in Kakariko and the whole flock takes revenge. Run indoors.
A hidden room holds 45 blue rupees and a note: "My name is Chris Houlihan. This is my top secret room."
MAME runs it on its Super Nintendo driver, which needs the console's sound chip ROM: snes.zip.
